query: Which procedures best reduce observer/reactivity bias in classroom observation studies (habituation, repeated visits, blind coders)?

response.query: Which procedures best reduce observer/reactivity bias in classroom observation studies (habituation, repeated visits, blind coders)?
response.answer: Repeated visits and blind coders best reduce observer/reactivity bias in classroom observation studies. Habituation also helps but is less effective than the other two methods.
